analysis: Integration of the 13 source-pass analyses plus replayed changelog and cli-reference patch. The PR is documentation, Swift CLI sandbox code and tests. It touches no provider keys, attestation, encryption, cache, or coordinator protocol. The one security-relevant change is the sandbox setup reordering (TB-013, T-061, A-019): install.sh is downloaded and executed with `--plan` as the Mac owner before the confirmation prompt (cli-reference.md head ~1051-1071, changelog line 7 'installer is now downloaded before the question'; SandboxSetupCommand.swift requestAddonPlan ~220-235; SandboxInstaller.supportsPlan/planArguments ~102-123). Multiple passes independently reported this. I consolidated it into one finding anchored on the docs line, which is directly visible in the replayed patch. Mitigations that remain: HTTPS-only download, 1 MiB cap, shebang check, 0600 file in a 0700 directory, no `--yes` on the plan run, stdin closed. Tests assert that ineligible or declined plans never reach install. None of these authenticate the script before first execution. Secondary observations that are not findings: the plan parser (SandboxSizingPlan) is strictly typed, schema 1 only; installer-provided `message` strings are printed to the terminal, so control-sequence stripping is worth checking at the same trust level; add-on 1.1.2 `background:true` background waiting and auto-enrollment is add-on behavior outside the supplied evidence and merits a TB-013 note; operator-chosen slot counts are no longer flagged above the estimate (A-018/T-059 local resource availability, low). Unverified: the full SandboxSetupCommand/SandboxChildProcess environment handling and whether the add-on honors `--plan` without side effects. Part of the replayed integration source was omitted (48 units), so deeper review is still warranted.

findings.detail: The head docs and Swift flow reorder `darkbloom sandbox setup` to download install.sh and run it with `/bin/sh <script> --plan --json-progress` (no `--yes`) as the Mac owner before the [y/N] confirmation (cli-reference.md steps 2-4; SandboxSetupCommand.swift requestAddonPlan). Before this PR the remote script ran only after consent. The CLI verifies the script only via TLS, and the only gate on running it is a substring check for `--plan` in the script's own text. A misissued certificate, compromised sandbox service, or hostile `--server` could serve a script that ignores `--plan` and acts immediately, so TB-013's consent gate no longer precedes first execution. 'Nothing is installed before y' now rests solely on the untrusted script's behavior. Non-interactive runs also now execute remote code before the 'stop without terminal' check. Fix: confirm before executing any downloaded script, or verify a pinned signature/hash of install.sh in the CLI before the plan run. Update TB-013/T-061 to record the pre-confirmation execution.
findings.title: Sandbox setup now runs the downloaded install.sh (--plan) as the Mac owner before the user confirms
